tasks.title: WHAT WAS ON THE STAND?
tasks.prompt: Compare the pre-show inventory and post-finale check. Which conclusion is supported?

options.text: The original was present at the finale.
The post-finale stand held the replica, while the original was later found in Repair Case 2.
Both masks were destroyed.
The original was never issued.

tasks.explanation: IC02 confirms original before return; IC03 confirms replica on stand; IC05 later finds original in repair case.
reference_sql: SELECT check_id, checked_at, location, item_id, observed_condition FROM sql02_inventory_checks ORDER BY checked_at

tasks.title: WHO HAD PROP RESPONSIBILITY
tasks.prompt: Join role assignments to characters. Who had the prop-custody lead duty during the relevant window?

options.text: Nikhil Rao
Kavya Sen
Dev Malhotra
Arjun Das

tasks.explanation: RA01 assigns prop custody lead to Dev. This is responsibility, not by itself proof of the swap.
reference_sql: SELECT c.display_name, r.duty, r.zone FROM sql02_role_assignments r JOIN sql02_characters c USING(character_id) WHERE r.duty ILIKE '%prop custody%'

tasks.title: PRESENCE VERSUS OPPORTUNITY
tasks.prompt: Nikhil appears in the access log near the stage-left wing. Which joined evidence most strongly weakens the claim that he performed the substitution?

options.text: His access event was denied.
He exited stage-left at 18:54, and the call sheet places him onstage from 18:55; the original returned to the prop bay at 18:57.
He never entered backstage.
He operated CUE-17.

tasks.explanation: The records place Nikhil onstage before the original returns to the prop bay. The badge alone isn't decisive; the combined sequence clears him of the substitution window.
reference_sql: SELECT a.event_time, a.event_type, a.zone, a.note FROM sql02_access_events a WHERE a.assigned_character_id='NIK' ORDER BY a.event_time
SELECT event_time, handled_by, from_location, to_location FROM sql02_prop_movements WHERE item_id='MASK-ORIG' ORDER BY event_time

tasks.title: THE SUBSTITUTION WINDOW
tasks.prompt: Join movements and inventory checks. Which event sequence best explains how the replica reached the finale stand?

options.text: The original was taken from the stand after the finale and the replica appeared later.
The original returned to the prop bay at 18:57; the replica moved from backup tray to stage-left at 18:59; the replica was on the display stand by 19:08.
Kavya moved the original from the AV booth.
The delivery marshal carried the mask out through the staff door.

tasks.explanation: The movement records and inventory checks provide a continuous substitution sequence; the delivery manifest lists fabric rolls only.
reference_sql: SELECT event_time, item_id, from_location, to_location, handled_by, reason FROM sql02_prop_movements WHERE item_id IN ('MASK-ORIG','MASK-REPL') ORDER BY event_time
SELECT checked_at, location, item_id, observed_condition FROM sql02_inventory_checks ORDER BY checked_at

tasks.title: THE CUE OPERATOR
tasks.prompt: Join cue records with role assignments and access events. Which interpretation fits the evidence?

options.text: Kavya triggered the cue, so she must have swapped the prop.
Kavya's cue log shows the wrong item but does not show prop handling; her assignment is AV operation, and no prop-bay access is recorded for her.
Kavya signed the original into Repair Case 2.
The cue log proves Nikhil carried the original.

tasks.explanation: Kavya executed the scheduled cue, but records don't put her in prop custody or show her moving either item.
reference_sql: SELECT q.event_time, q.cue_code, c.display_name, q.planned_item_id, q.observed_item_id, q.note FROM sql02_cue_log q JOIN sql02_characters c ON c.character_id=q.operator_id ORDER BY q.event_time
SELECT * FROM sql02_access_events WHERE assigned_character_id='KAV' ORDER BY event_time

tasks.title: THE COVER STORY
tasks.prompt: Join the original's movement history to the direct messages. Which explanation is best supported?

options.text: Dev deliberately used the backup and kept the original for a clasp repair, concealing the move because he feared the producer would cancel the finale.
Nikhil stole the mask to sabotage his own performance.
Kavya swapped the mask to improve the camera shot.
Arjun removed the mask during the fabric delivery.

tasks.explanation: Dev handled the original's return and later repair-case movement, instructed Sana to use the backup without notifying the producer, and admitted the unlogged move. The motive is avoiding cancellation, not permanent theft.
reference_sql: SELECT m.event_time, m.item_id, m.from_location, m.to_location, c.display_name AS handler, m.reason FROM sql02_prop_movements m JOIN sql02_characters c ON c.character_id=m.handled_by WHERE m.item_id='MASK-ORIG' ORDER BY m.event_time
SELECT sent_at, sender_id, recipient_id, subject, body FROM sql02_messages WHERE sender_id='DEV' ORDER BY sent_at
